datasets.name: workflow_status
queryLines:
WITH configured_workflows AS (
-- Generated from active entries in workflow-monitoring.yml.
{{CONFIGURED_WORKFLOWS}}
),
-- Resolve each configured name or ID to the latest live job record.
latest_jobs AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, delete_time
  FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE workspace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM configured_workflows)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
name_matches AS (
  SELECT c.configured_order, COUNT(j.job_id) AS match_count, MAX(j.job_id) AS matched_job_id, MAX(j.name) AS matched_job_name
  FROM configured_workflows c
  LEFT JOIN latest_jobs j ON c.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id IS NULL AND c.configured_job_name = j.name AND j.delete_time IS NULL
  GROUP BY c.configured_order
),
resolved_workflows AS (
  SELECT c.*,
    CASE WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN id_job.job_id ELSE CASE WHEN n.match_count = 1 THEN n.matched_job_id END END AS resolved_job_id,
    c.configured_job_name AS workflow_name,
    CASE
      WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NOT NULL AND id_job.job_id IS NULL THEN 'Missing job ID'
      WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NOT NULL AND id_job.name <> c.configured_job_name THEN 'Job ID and name mismatch'
      WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NULL AND n.match_count = 0 THEN 'Missing job name'
      WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NULL AND n.match_count > 1 THEN 'Ambiguous job name'
    END AS configuration_problem
  FROM configured_workflows c
  LEFT JOIN latest_jobs id_job ON c.workspace_id = id_job.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id = id_job.job_id AND id_job.delete_time IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN name_matches n ON c.configured_order = n.configured_order
),
workflow_runs AS (
  SELECT r.configured_order, r.workspace_id, r.resolved_job_id, t.run_id, MIN(t.period_start_time) AS run_start_time, MAX(t.period_end_time) AS run_end_time, MAX(t.result_state) AS result_state
  FROM resolved_workflows r INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t ON r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND r.resolved_job_id = t.job_id
  WHERE t.period_start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 365)
  GROUP BY r.configured_order, r.workspace_id, r.resolved_job_id, t.run_id HAVING MAX(t.result_state) IS NOT NULL
),
latest_runs AS (
  SELECT * FROM workflow_runs
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY configured_order ORDER BY run_end_time DESC, run_id DESC) = 1
),
latest_run_compute AS (
  SELECT r.configured_order, CASE
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(u.sku_name) LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN u.sku_name IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(u.sku_name) NOT LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Mixed'
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(u.sku_name) LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Serverless'
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN u.sku_name IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(u.sku_name) NOT LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Classic jobs compute'
    ELSE 'Unknown' END AS compute_type
  FROM latest_runs r
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.usage u ON r.workspace_id = u.workspace_id AND r.resolved_job_id = u.usage_metadata.job_id AND r.run_id = u.usage_metadata.job_run_id AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 365)
  GROUP BY r.configured_order
),
today_counts AS (
  SELECT configured_order,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN run_id END) AS successful_runs_today,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT', 'BLOCKED', 'CANCELLED', 'SKIPPED') THEN run_id END) AS failed_runs_today
  FROM workflow_runs
  WHERE to_date(from_utc_timestamp(run_end_time, 'UTC')) = to_date(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'UTC'))
  GROUP BY configured_order
),
workflow_local_dates AS (
  SELECT r.*, to_date(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), timezone)) AS local_today,
    CASE day_of_week WHEN 'sunday' THEN 1 WHEN 'monday' THEN 2 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 4 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 5 WHEN 'friday' THEN 6 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 7 END AS target_day
  FROM resolved_workflows r WHERE resolved_job_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Build the nearby deadline dates for each supported schedule.
deadline_dates AS (
  SELECT w.*, deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(date_sub(local_today, 1), date_add(local_today, 1))) d AS deadline_date WHERE frequency = 'daily'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.*, date_add(date_add(local_today, -pmod(dayofweek(local_today) - target_day, 7)), offset * 7) AS deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(-1, 1)) o AS offset WHERE frequency = 'weekly'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.*, date_add(first_deadline_date, (CAST(FLOOR(datediff(local_today, first_deadline_date) / 14.0) AS INT) + offset) * 14) AS deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(-1, 1)) o AS offset WHERE frequency = 'fortnightly'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.*, date_add(to_date(add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', local_today), offset)), LEAST(day_of_month, day(last_day(add_months(local_today, offset)))) - 1) AS deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(-1, 1)) o AS offset WHERE frequency = 'monthly'
),
deadline_instants AS (
  SELECT *, to_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(concat(CAST(deadline_date AS STRING), ' ', completion_time), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), timezone) AS deadline_utc
  FROM deadline_dates
),
deadline_periods AS (
  SELECT *, LAG(deadline_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY configured_order ORDER BY deadline_utc) AS previous_deadline_utc
  FROM deadline_instants
),
-- A period is met only when a successful run completed before its deadline.
deadline_results AS (
  SELECT d.configured_order, d.deadline_utc,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN r.run_id END) > 0 THEN 'Met' WHEN d.deadline_utc <= current_timestamp() THEN 'Missed' ELSE 'Pending' END AS deadline_status
  FROM deadline_periods d
  LEFT JOIN workflow_runs r ON d.configured_order = r.configured_order AND r.run_end_time > d.previous_deadline_utc AND r.run_end_time <= d.deadline_utc
  WHERE d.previous_deadline_utc IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.configured_order, d.deadline_utc
),
last_due AS (
  SELECT * FROM deadline_results WHERE deadline_utc <= current_timestamp()
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY configured_order ORDER BY deadline_utc DESC) = 1
),
next_due AS (
  SELECT * FROM deadline_results WHERE deadline_utc > current_timestamp()
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY configured_order ORDER BY deadline_utc) = 1
)
SELECT r.configured_order, r.workflow_name, r.configured_job_name, r.resolved_job_id AS job_id, r.frequency, r.timezone,
  COALESCE(c.compute_type, 'Unknown') AS compute_type, r.configuration_problem,
  lr.result_state AS latest_run_result, lr.run_end_time AS latest_run_end_time, n.deadline_utc AS next_deadline_utc,
  CASE WHEN r.resolved_job_id IS NULL THEN CAST(NULL AS STRING) WHEN l.deadline_status = 'Missed' THEN 'Missed' ELSE COALESCE(n.deadline_status, l.deadline_status, 'Pending') END AS sla_status,
  CASE WHEN r.configuration_problem IS NOT NULL OR r.resolved_job_id IS NULL THEN 'Configuration problem' WHEN l.deadline_status = 'Missed' THEN 'Missed' ELSE COALESCE(n.deadline_status, l.deadline_status, 'Pending') END AS health_status,
  1 AS monitored_workflow_count, COALESCE(t.successful_runs_today, 0) AS successful_runs_today, COALESCE(t.failed_runs_today, 0) AS failed_runs_today,
  CASE WHEN r.resolved_job_id IS NOT NULL AND l.deadline_status <> 'Missed' AND COALESCE(n.deadline_status, 'Pending') = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sla_pending_flag,
  CASE WHEN r.resolved_job_id IS NOT NULL AND l.deadline_status = 'Missed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sla_missed_flag,
  CASE WHEN r.configuration_problem IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS configuration_problem_flag,
  CASE WHEN r.configuration_problem IS NOT NULL OR l.deadline_status = 'Missed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS needs_attention_flag
FROM resolved_workflows r
LEFT JOIN latest_runs lr ON r.configured_order = lr.configured_order
LEFT JOIN latest_run_compute c ON r.configured_order = c.configured_order
LEFT JOIN today_counts t ON r.configured_order = t.configured_order
LEFT JOIN last_due l ON r.configured_order = l.configured_order
LEFT JOIN next_due n ON r.configured_order = n.configured_order
ORDER BY r.configured_order

datasets.name: run_history
queryLines:
WITH configured_workflows AS (
-- Generated from active entries in workflow-monitoring.yml.
{{CONFIGURED_WORKFLOWS}}
),
-- Resolve configured workflows, then keep only completed job runs.
latest_jobs AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, delete_time FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE workspace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM configured_workflows)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
name_matches AS (
  SELECT c.configured_order, COUNT(j.job_id) AS match_count, MAX(j.job_id) AS matched_job_id, MAX(j.name) AS matched_job_name
  FROM configured_workflows c LEFT JOIN latest_jobs j ON c.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id IS NULL AND c.configured_job_name = j.name AND j.delete_time IS NULL
  GROUP BY c.configured_order
),
resolved_workflows AS (
  SELECT c.configured_order, c.workspace_id, c.configured_job_name AS workflow_name,
    CASE WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN id_job.job_id WHEN n.match_count = 1 THEN n.matched_job_id END AS resolved_job_id
  FROM configured_workflows c
  LEFT JOIN latest_jobs id_job ON c.workspace_id = id_job.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id = id_job.job_id AND id_job.delete_time IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN name_matches n ON c.configured_order = n.configured_order
),
monitored_runs AS (
  SELECT r.configured_order, r.workflow_name, r.workspace_id, r.resolved_job_id AS job_id, t.run_id, MIN(t.period_start_time) AS run_start_time, MAX(t.period_end_time) AS run_end_time, MAX(t.result_state) AS result_state
  FROM resolved_workflows r INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t ON r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND r.resolved_job_id = t.job_id
  WHERE t.period_start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 365)
  GROUP BY r.configured_order, r.workflow_name, r.workspace_id, r.resolved_job_id, t.run_id HAVING MAX(t.result_state) IS NOT NULL
),
-- Billing metadata keeps compute classification in one bounded source.
run_compute_types AS (
  SELECT r.workspace_id, r.job_id, r.run_id, CASE
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(u.sku_name) LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN u.sku_name IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(u.sku_name) NOT LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Mixed'
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(u.sku_name) LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Serverless'
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN u.sku_name IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(u.sku_name) NOT LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Classic jobs compute'
    ELSE 'Unknown' END AS compute_type
  FROM monitored_runs r LEFT JOIN system.billing.usage u ON r.workspace_id = u.workspace_id AND r.job_id = u.usage_metadata.job_id AND r.run_id = u.usage_metadata.job_run_id AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 365)
  GROUP BY r.workspace_id, r.job_id, r.run_id
)
SELECT r.workflow_name, r.job_id, r.run_id, to_date(from_utc_timestamp(r.run_end_time, 'UTC')) AS run_date, r.run_start_time, r.run_end_time,
  unix_timestamp(r.run_end_time) - unix_timestamp(r.run_start_time) AS duration_seconds, r.result_state,
  CASE WHEN r.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'Success' ELSE 'Failure' END AS run_outcome,
  c.compute_type
FROM monitored_runs r
LEFT JOIN run_compute_types c ON r.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND r.job_id = c.job_id AND r.run_id = c.run_id
ORDER BY r.run_end_time DESC

columns.description: Share of completed runs that succeeded
columns.expression: TRY_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN `result_state` = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(`run_id`))

columns.description: Mean duration of completed workflow runs

datasets.name: sla_history
queryLines:
WITH configured_workflows AS (
-- Generated from active entries in workflow-monitoring.yml.
{{CONFIGURED_WORKFLOWS}}
),
-- Resolve workflows and collect enough run history to evaluate one year.
latest_jobs AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, delete_time FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE workspace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM configured_workflows)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
name_matches AS (
  SELECT c.configured_order, COUNT(j.job_id) AS match_count, MAX(j.job_id) AS matched_job_id, MAX(j.name) AS matched_job_name
  FROM configured_workflows c LEFT JOIN latest_jobs j ON c.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id IS NULL AND c.configured_job_name = j.name AND j.delete_time IS NULL
  GROUP BY c.configured_order
),
resolved_workflows AS (
  SELECT c.*, c.configured_job_name AS workflow_name,
    CASE WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN id_job.job_id WHEN n.match_count = 1 THEN n.matched_job_id END AS resolved_job_id
  FROM configured_workflows c
  LEFT JOIN latest_jobs id_job ON c.workspace_id = id_job.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id = id_job.job_id AND id_job.delete_time IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN name_matches n ON c.configured_order = n.configured_order
),
workflow_runs AS (
  SELECT r.configured_order, t.run_id, MIN(t.period_start_time) AS run_start_time, MAX(t.period_end_time) AS run_end_time, MAX(t.result_state) AS result_state
  FROM resolved_workflows r INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t ON r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND r.resolved_job_id = t.job_id
  WHERE t.period_start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 380)
  GROUP BY r.configured_order, t.run_id HAVING MAX(t.result_state) IS NOT NULL
),
workflow_local_dates AS (
  SELECT r.*, to_date(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), timezone)) AS local_today,
    CASE day_of_week WHEN 'sunday' THEN 1 WHEN 'monday' THEN 2 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 4 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 5 WHEN 'friday' THEN 6 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 7 END AS target_day
  FROM resolved_workflows r WHERE resolved_job_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Generate historical deadlines in each workflow's local timezone.
deadline_dates AS (
  SELECT w.*, deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(date_sub(local_today, 380), date_add(local_today, 1))) d AS deadline_date WHERE frequency = 'daily'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.*, date_add(date_add(date_sub(local_today, 380), pmod(target_day - dayofweek(date_sub(local_today, 380)), 7)), offset * 7) AS deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(0, 56)) o AS offset WHERE frequency = 'weekly'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.*, date_add(first_deadline_date, (CAST(FLOOR(datediff(local_today, first_deadline_date) / 14.0) AS INT) + offset) * 14) AS deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(-28, 1)) o AS offset WHERE frequency = 'fortnightly'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.*, date_add(to_date(add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', local_today), offset)), LEAST(day_of_month, day(last_day(add_months(local_today, offset)))) - 1) AS deadline_date FROM workflow_local_dates w LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(sequence(-13, 1)) o AS offset WHERE frequency = 'monthly'
),
deadline_instants AS (
  SELECT *, to_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(concat(CAST(deadline_date AS STRING), ' ', completion_time), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), timezone) AS deadline_utc
  FROM deadline_dates WHERE deadline_date BETWEEN date_sub(local_today, 380) AND date_add(local_today, 31)
),
deadline_periods AS (
  SELECT *,
    LAG(deadline_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY configured_order ORDER BY deadline_utc) AS previous_deadline_utc,
    LEAD(deadline_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY configured_order ORDER BY deadline_utc) AS next_deadline_utc
  FROM deadline_instants
),
-- Keep SLA status separate from a later recovery so missed history never changes.
on_time_deadlines AS (
  SELECT d.configured_order, d.workflow_name, d.deadline_utc, d.next_deadline_utc, d.timezone,
    MIN(CASE WHEN r.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN r.run_end_time END) AS on_time_completion_utc,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN r.run_id END) > 0 THEN 'Met' WHEN d.deadline_utc <= current_timestamp() THEN 'Missed' ELSE 'Pending' END AS sla_status
  FROM deadline_periods d
  LEFT JOIN workflow_runs r ON d.configured_order = r.configured_order AND r.run_end_time > d.previous_deadline_utc AND r.run_end_time <= d.deadline_utc
  WHERE d.previous_deadline_utc IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.configured_order, d.workflow_name, d.deadline_utc, d.next_deadline_utc, d.timezone
),
late_recoveries AS (
  SELECT d.configured_order, d.deadline_utc, MIN(r.run_end_time) AS late_recovery_utc
  FROM deadline_periods d
  LEFT JOIN workflow_runs r ON d.configured_order = r.configured_order AND r.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' AND r.run_end_time > d.deadline_utc AND r.run_end_time <= d.next_deadline_utc
  WHERE d.previous_deadline_utc IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.configured_order, d.deadline_utc
),
observed_deadlines AS (
  SELECT d.*, COALESCE(d.on_time_completion_utc, r.late_recovery_utc) AS observed_completion_utc,
    CASE WHEN d.sla_status = 'Missed' AND r.late_recovery_utc IS NOT NULL THEN 'Late recovery' ELSE d.sla_status END AS delivery_state
  FROM on_time_deadlines d
  LEFT JOIN late_recoveries r ON d.configured_order = r.configured_order AND d.deadline_utc = r.deadline_utc
),
deadline_results AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROUND((unix_timestamp(deadline_utc) - unix_timestamp(observed_completion_utc)) / 60.0, 1) AS completion_margin_minutes,
    COALESCE(ROUND((unix_timestamp(deadline_utc) - unix_timestamp(observed_completion_utc)) / 60.0, 1), 0.0) AS display_margin_minutes
  FROM observed_deadlines
),
run_metrics_30d AS (
  SELECT configured_order, COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS total_runs_30d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN run_id END) AS successful_runs_30d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT', 'BLOCKED', 'CANCELLED', 'SKIPPED') THEN run_id END) AS failed_runs_30d,
    AVG(unix_timestamp(run_end_time) - unix_timestamp(run_start_time)) AS average_duration_seconds_30d
  FROM workflow_runs WHERE run_end_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY configured_order
),
priced_usage_30d AS (
  SELECT u.workspace_id, u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id, u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.effective_list.default AS list_cost_usd
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud AND p.currency_code = 'USD' AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time AND (u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time OR p.price_end_time IS NULL)
  WHERE u.workspace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM configured_workflows) AND u.billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)
),
cost_metrics_30d AS (
  SELECT r.configured_order, SUM(u.list_cost_usd) AS estimated_list_cost_30d
  FROM resolved_workflows r INNER JOIN priced_usage_30d u ON r.workspace_id = u.workspace_id AND r.resolved_job_id = u.job_id
  GROUP BY r.configured_order
),
sla_metrics_30d AS (
  SELECT configured_order,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sla_status IN ('Met', 'Missed') THEN 1 END) AS evaluated_deadlines_30d,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sla_status = 'Met' THEN 1 END) AS met_deadlines_30d,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sla_status = 'Missed' THEN 1 END) AS missed_deadlines_30d
  FROM deadline_results
  WHERE deadline_utc >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) AND deadline_utc <= current_timestamp()
  GROUP BY configured_order
)
SELECT d.workflow_name, to_date(from_utc_timestamp(d.deadline_utc, d.timezone)) AS deadline_date, d.deadline_utc, d.timezone,
  datediff(to_date(from_utc_timestamp(d.deadline_utc, d.timezone)), to_date(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), d.timezone))) AS deadline_day_offset,
  d.sla_status, d.delivery_state, d.observed_completion_utc, d.completion_margin_minutes, d.display_margin_minutes,
  CASE WHEN d.deadline_utc <= current_timestamp() THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.configured_order, CASE WHEN d.deadline_utc <= current_timestamp() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY d.deadline_utc DESC) END AS due_deadline_recency,
  CAST(0.99 AS DECIMAL(4, 2)) AS sla_target_rate,
  TRY_DIVIDE(r.successful_runs_30d, r.total_runs_30d) AS run_success_rate_30d,
  TRY_DIVIDE(s.met_deadlines_30d, s.evaluated_deadlines_30d) AS sla_compliance_rate_30d,
  COALESCE(c.estimated_list_cost_30d, 0.0) AS estimated_list_cost_30d, r.average_duration_seconds_30d,
  COALESCE(r.total_runs_30d, 0) AS total_runs_30d, COALESCE(r.failed_runs_30d, 0) AS failed_runs_30d,
  COALESCE(s.evaluated_deadlines_30d, 0) AS evaluated_deadlines_30d, COALESCE(s.missed_deadlines_30d, 0) AS missed_deadlines_30d,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.missed_deadlines_30d, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(r.failed_runs_30d, 0) > 0 THEN 'Critical' WHEN COALESCE(s.missed_deadlines_30d, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(r.failed_runs_30d, 0) > 0 THEN 'Needs attention' ELSE 'Healthy' END AS attention_level
FROM deadline_results d
LEFT JOIN run_metrics_30d r ON d.configured_order = r.configured_order
LEFT JOIN cost_metrics_30d c ON d.configured_order = c.configured_order
LEFT JOIN sla_metrics_30d s ON d.configured_order = s.configured_order
WHERE d.deadline_utc >= date_sub(current_date(), 365)
ORDER BY d.deadline_utc

columns.description: Share of evaluated deadlines that were met
columns.expression: TRY_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN `sla_status` = 'Met' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN `sla_status` IN ('Met', 'Missed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))

datasets.name: daily_cost
queryLines:
WITH configured_workflows AS (
-- Generated from active entries in workflow-monitoring.yml.
{{CONFIGURED_WORKFLOWS}}
),
-- Resolve configured workflows before joining their billing usage.
latest_jobs AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, delete_time FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE workspace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM configured_workflows)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
name_matches AS (
  SELECT c.configured_order, COUNT(j.job_id) AS match_count, MAX(j.job_id) AS matched_job_id, MAX(j.name) AS matched_job_name
  FROM configured_workflows c LEFT JOIN latest_jobs j ON c.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id IS NULL AND c.configured_job_name = j.name AND j.delete_time IS NULL
  GROUP BY c.configured_order
),
resolved_workflows AS (
  SELECT c.workspace_id, c.configured_job_name AS workflow_name,
    CASE WHEN c.configured_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN id_job.job_id WHEN n.match_count = 1 THEN n.matched_job_id END AS resolved_job_id
  FROM configured_workflows c
  LEFT JOIN latest_jobs id_job ON c.workspace_id = id_job.workspace_id AND c.configured_job_id = id_job.job_id AND id_job.delete_time IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN name_matches n ON c.configured_order = n.configured_order
),
-- Apply the list price that was effective when each usage record ended.
priced_usage AS (
  SELECT u.workspace_id, u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id, u.usage_date, u.sku_name, u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.effective_list.default AS list_cost_usd
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud AND p.currency_code = 'USD' AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time AND (u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time OR p.price_end_time IS NULL)
  WHERE u.workspace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM configured_workflows) AND u.billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 365)
),
workflow_daily_cost AS (
  SELECT r.workflow_name, u.usage_date, SUM(u.list_cost_usd) AS list_cost_usd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(u.sku_name) LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uses_serverless,
    MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(u.sku_name) NOT LIKE '%SERVERLESS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uses_classic
  FROM resolved_workflows r INNER JOIN priced_usage u ON r.workspace_id = u.workspace_id AND r.resolved_job_id = u.job_id
  GROUP BY r.workflow_name, u.usage_date
)
SELECT workflow_name, usage_date, list_cost_usd, CASE WHEN uses_serverless = 1 AND uses_classic = 1 THEN 'Mixed' WHEN uses_serverless = 1 THEN 'Serverless' WHEN uses_classic = 1 THEN 'Classic jobs compute' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS compute_type
FROM workflow_daily_cost ORDER BY usage_date, workflow_name
